dialDefs.label: World food price
dialDefs.description: Outside-world price of food. The Trading Post sells imports above it and buys surplus below it.

dialDefs.label: World timber price
dialDefs.description: Outside-world price of timber.

dialDefs.label: World copper price
dialDefs.description: What the outside world pays for copper before the town floods the market.

dialDefs.label: World gold price
dialDefs.description: What the outside world pays for gold before the town floods the market.

dialDefs.label: Import markup
dialDefs.description: Imports cost world price times this; food and timber surplus sells for world price divided by it.

dialDefs.label: Export market depth
dialDefs.description: How much copper the outside world takes per shift at each price tier before the price steps down. Gold uses a quarter of this.

dialDefs.label: World price volatility
dialDefs.description: How much outside-world prices wander each shift.

dialDefs.label: Export levy
dialDefs.description: Share of Trading Post sales that goes to the town treasury.

dialDefs.label: Interest rate
dialDefs.description: Base daily interest on loans. The bank charges up to 3x this when its reserves run low.

dialDefs.label: Loan term
dialDefs.description: Days to repay a loan in equal installments.

dialDefs.label: Missed payments to default
dialDefs.description: Consecutive missed payments before the bank forecloses.

dialDefs.label: Credit ban
dialDefs.description: How long a defaulter is barred from borrowing.

dialDefs.label: Base loan limit
dialDefs.description: What anyone can borrow before income and net worth are counted.

dialDefs.label: Credit freeze point
dialDefs.description: The bank stops lending when its reserves fall below this share of its starting reserves.

dialDefs.label: Bunkhouse rent
dialDefs.description: Rent for a bunkhouse bed. Miners who can't pay sleep rough.

dialDefs.label: House lot price
dialDefs.description: Paid to the town to start building on an empty lot.

dialDefs.label: House timber
dialDefs.description: Timber needed to start a house.

dialDefs.label: House copper
dialDefs.description: Copper needed to start a house.

dialDefs.label: House labour
dialDefs.description: Skill-weighted shifts of work to finish a house.

dialDefs.label: Foreclosure salvage
dialDefs.description: What the town pays the bank for a foreclosed house.

dialDefs.label: Soup kitchen
dialDefs.description: Rations the treasury imports each day for hungry miners who have no food and almost no cash.

dialDefs.label: Relief cash threshold
dialDefs.description: Miners with less cash than this can get relief when hungry.

dialDefs.label: Wealth tax
dialDefs.description: Daily share of cash above the exemption paid to the treasury (and so back to everyone as the dividend).

dialDefs.label: Wealth tax exemption
dialDefs.description: Cash below this is never taxed.

dialDefs.label: Treasury reserve
dialDefs.description: The treasury shares a tenth of anything above this equally among all miners each day.

dialDefs.label: Hunger rate
dialDefs.description: Nourishment lost each shift.

dialDefs.label: Meal size
dialDefs.description: Nourishment restored by eating one food.

dialDefs.label: Appetite
dialDefs.description: Miners eat automatically when nourishment drops below this.

dialDefs.label: Work fatigue
dialDefs.description: Energy a shift of work costs.

dialDefs.label: Rest recovery
dialDefs.description: Energy a shift of rest restores in a house (less in the bunkhouse, much less sleeping rough).

dialDefs.label: Starvation damage
dialDefs.description: Health lost each shift with no nourishment.

dialDefs.label: Healing
dialDefs.description: Health regained each shift when fed (doubled when resting).

dialDefs.label: Price of comforts
dialDefs.description: Coins of imported comforts that take a miner from no comfort to full comfort. The money leaves the valley.

dialDefs.label: Comfort wear-off
dialDefs.description: How fast comfort fades.

dialDefs.label: Food spoilage
dialDefs.description: Share of stored food that rots each shift.

dialDefs.label: Farm yield
dialDefs.description: Food from one average farmer-shift on a fertile plot.

dialDefs.label: Chop yield
dialDefs.description: Timber from one average chopper-shift in a full forest.

dialDefs.label: Forest regrowth
dialDefs.description: Logistic regrowth rate of forests: fastest at half-full, slow when stripped.

dialDefs.label: Soil exhaustion
dialDefs.description: Fertility lost per shift of farming.

dialDefs.label: Soil recovery
dialDefs.description: Fertility regained each shift.

dialDefs.label: Copper dig yield
dialDefs.description: Copper ore from an average miner-shift at the surface of an average vein.

dialDefs.label: Gold dig yield
dialDefs.description: Gold from an average miner-shift at the surface of an average gold vein.

dialDefs.label: Ore per depth level
dialDefs.description: Ore dug out before a shaft gets one level deeper (harder, poorer, needs another support).

dialDefs.label: Timber per support
dialDefs.description: Timber needed to shore up each new level of a shaft.

dialDefs.label: Cave-in risk
dialDefs.description: Base chance of a cave-in per dig; multiplied by unsupported depth and hardness.

dialDefs.label: Injury length
dialDefs.description: How long a cave-in or lightning strike keeps a miner off work.

dialDefs.label: Smelt capacity
dialDefs.description: Ore an average worker can smelt in a shift. Two ore make one copper.

dialDefs.label: Smelter fee cap
dialDefs.description: Town regulation: the most a smelter owner may charge per unit of ore.

dialDefs.label: Smelt fuel
dialDefs.description: Timber burned per unit of ore smelted.

dialDefs.label: Boon size
dialDefs.description: Default windfall granted by a boon.

dialDefs.label: Lightning damage
dialDefs.description: Share of a struck miner's goods destroyed by lightning.
